predecessors.name: Thakuri dynasty
predecessors.text: the Kathmandu Valley under the Malla dynasty

ledger.x: c. 1201: Arimalla founds the Malla dynasty of the valley. Infobox 'Established: c. 1201'; 'Arimalla (reigned 1200-16) was the first king to be so-called'. The page does not name his predecessors; the Kathmandu page has 'The Licchavi era was followed by the Malla era'.
1484: Ratna Malla makes Kathmandu a kingdom of its own.
1597: Sivasimha Malla unites Patan with Kathmandu.
26 September 1744: the Gorkhalis storm Nuwakot, opening the war for the valley.
25 September 1768: Prithvi Narayan Shah takes Kathmandu.
September 1768: the Kingdom of Kantipur ends.

wars.name: Gorkha conquest of the Kathmandu Valley
wars.outcome: Nuwakot taken 26 September 1744; Naikap base against Kirtipur 1757; peace treaty 1758; Kirtipur assaulted again in 1764 and captured in 1766 (timeline); Gorkha defeats a British force at Sindhuli in 1767 that came 'to help king of Kathmandu'; Kathmandu falls…

wars.name: Sivasimha Malla's conquest of Patan
wars.outcome: 'conquered it in 1597 and united it with Kathmandu'; separated again later (no year).

certainty.note: The valley rim is a natural boundary, but no page gives a frontier; the shape is Cliopatria's single 661 km2 outline.
